title: Problem
问题
html:
Medical reasoning data is expensive to distill and underrepresents rare diseases, so larger generic trace sets do not reliably improve the long tail.

MedSSR controls question synthesis with rare-disease knowledge, lets the policy produce pseudo-labels, and combines self-supervised with human-anchored reinforcement learning. The decision boundary is whether a serialized training record survives medical answer rewards, pseudo-label confidence, human-annotated real data, and two-stage RL; the central artifact is data consumed by medical reasoning SFT and semi-supervised RL, not a model-only release.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2604.11547; Findings of ACL 2026; data object MedSSR-Synthetic-43K with 43K synthetic medical reasoning records; evaluation surface Across Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the method outperforms compared approaches on ten medical benchmarks and reports up to a 5.93% gain on rare-disease tasks.; collection note: full paper, official README, license, schema, and an actual public record checked on 2026-07-27.

医学推理轨迹蒸馏成本高且罕见病覆盖不足，扩大通用轨迹并不能可靠改善长尾。

该方法用罕见病知识控制问题合成，让策略模型生成伪标签，再结合自监督和人工锚定的强化学习。 判定边界是记录能否通过医学答案奖励、伪标签置信度、人工真实数据和两阶段强化学习并成为医学推理监督微调与半监督强化学习的输入；中心产物是训练数据，而不是只发布模型。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2604.11547；来源状态为ACL 2026 Findings；数据对象是 MedSSR-Synthetic-43K，规模为4.3 万条合成医学推理记录；评估锚点为在两种 8B 骨干和十个医学基准上，该方法整体超过对比方案，并在罕见病任务上最高提升 5.93%。；已于 2026-07-27 阅读全文、官方说明、许可、字段和一条公开实际记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MedSSR controls question synthesis with rare-disease knowledge, lets the policy produce pseudo-labels, and combines self-supervised with human-anchored reinforcement learning. Relative to proprietary-teacher CoT distillation followed by standard RL, it makes medical prompt, retrieved rare-disease knowledge, model-generated reasoning, answer, and reward metadata the reusable target and uses medical answer rewards, pseudo-label confidence, human-annotated real data, and two-stage RL as the feedback contract, so Track 01 is the correct category.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: medical questions combined with controllable rare-disease knowledge. Operation: Normalize prompts, media, provenance, and reference fields into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject missing task inputs, source identifiers, or access terms.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: Each normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: the policy model generates pseudo-label reasoning instead of relying only on a proprietary teacher. Output and transition: A serialized response, reasoning trace, or tool trajectory advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to the prompt, teacher, or source evidence.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and the paper's correctness metadata. Operation: Apply medical answer rewards, pseudo-label confidence, human-annotated real data, and two-stage RL. Output and transition: Passing records form 43K synthetic medical reasoning records stored as Parquet records. Check / stop rule: Reject failures; do not treat final-answer agreement as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The versioned release and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for medical reasoning SFT and semi-supervised RL and compare with proprietary-teacher CoT distillation followed by standard RL. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the controlled evidence reported by the paper. Check / stop rule: Pin data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, and harness; stop claims at the evaluated domains.

Reproducibility requires the official data revision, generation settings, verifier/tool versions, random seeds, split, base model, and evaluation harness. Unreported budgets remain unknown.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：医学问题与可控的罕见病知识组合。 操作：统一题目、媒体、来源和参考字段，形成候选记录。 输出及流转：可审计候选进入目标生成阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少任务输入、来源标识或使用条款时拒绝。

步骤 2——写入可复用目标。 输入：标准化候选及其来源证据。 操作：策略模型自身生成伪标签推理，而不只依赖封闭教师。 输出及流转：序列化回答、推理过程或工具轨迹进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：目标无法对应题目、生成者或来源证据时停止。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成目标和论文定义的正确性信息。 操作：执行医学答案奖励、伪标签置信度、人工真实数据和两阶段强化学习。 输出及流转：通过的记录组成官方发布并按数据页格式保存。 检查与停止规则：失败记录被拒绝；最终答案一致不代表每个中间步骤正确。

步骤 4——训练并评估消费者。 输入：固定版本的数据与论文基础模型。 操作：用于医学推理监督微调与半监督强化学习，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的消费者和论文报告的受控证据。 检查与停止规则：固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型和评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

复现还需固定数据版本、生成设置、验证器或工具版本、随机种子、切分、基础模型和评测器；未披露预算保持未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Experiment 1: Across Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the method outperforms compared approaches on ten medical benchmarks and reports up to a 5.93% gain on rare-disease tasks.

Experiment 2: The released artifact contains 43K synthetic medical reasoning records; on 2026-07-27 the official Hub page exposed an actual record with fields medical prompt, retrieved rare-disease knowledge, model-generated reasoning, answer, and reward metadata and reported 14 downloads. Artifact use does not by itself validate the paper's causal claim.

实验 1：在两种 8B 骨干和十个医学基准上，该方法整体超过对比方案，并在罕见病任务上最高提升 5.93%。

实验 2：官方发布规模为4.3 万条合成医学推理记录。2026-07-27 的数据页可读取含医学问题、检索到的罕见病知识、模型推理、答案和奖励元数据的实际记录并显示 14 次下载；使用量不能代替因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest prior baseline is proprietary-teacher CoT distillation followed by standard RL. The paper changes the reusable object by making medical prompt, retrieved rare-disease knowledge, model-generated reasoning, answer, and reward metadata explicit and coupling it to medical answer rewards, pseudo-label confidence, human-annotated real data, and two-stage RL. This is a direction signal because another team can train the stated consumer from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是封闭教师思维链蒸馏后接标准强化学习的方法。真正变化是把医学问题、检索到的罕见病知识、模型推理、答案和奖励元数据显式化，并与医学答案奖励、伪标签置信度、人工真实数据和两阶段强化学习绑定。另一团队可以直接用公开记录训练所述消费者，因此这是数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. pseudo-labels can reinforce the policy's own diagnostic errors.
  2. The published checks do not establish that every intermediate reasoning step is correct or causally necessary.
  3. Reuse must preserve Apache-2.0 and any upstream media or source-data terms.

1. 伪标签可能强化策略自身的诊断错误；合成知识组合也未必符合真实临床患病分布。
  2. 已公开检查不能证明每个中间推理步骤都正确或不可替代。
  3. 复用必须保留官方许可，并继续遵守所有上游媒体或来源数据条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the dataset to build or ablate medical reasoning SFT and semi-supervised RL; preserve provenance and compare a fixed backbone before attributing gains to the traces.
  • Audit a stratified sample against medical answer rewards, pseudo-label confidence, human-annotated real data, and two-stage RL. The output should be a versioned keep/reject ledger, not only a benchmark score.

• 可用该数据构建或消融医学推理监督微调与半监督强化学习；保留来源并固定骨干后，才能把收益归因于轨迹。
  • 按来源和难度分层抽样，依据医学答案奖励、伪标签置信度、人工真实数据和两阶段强化学习复核。输出应是带版本的保留与拒绝台账，而不只是基准分数。

阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: MedSSR controls question synthesis with rare-disease knowledge, lets the policy produce pseudo-labels, and combines self-supervised with human-anchored reinforcement learning.
  • Data object: medical prompt, retrieved rare-disease knowledge, model-generated reasoning, answer, and reward metadata.
  • Author and selector: the policy model generates pseudo-label reasoning instead of relying only on a proprietary teacher; selection uses medical answer rewards, pseudo-label confidence, human-annotated real data, and two-stage RL.
  • Evidence anchor: Across Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the method outperforms compared approaches on ten medical benchmarks and reports up to a 5.93% gain on rare-disease tasks.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for medical reasoning SFT and semi-supervised RL; first audit pseudo-labels can reinforce the policy's own diagnostic errors, and synthetic knowledge combinations may not represent clinical prevalence.

  • 数据对象：医学问题、检索到的罕见病知识、模型推理、答案和奖励元数据。

  • 证据锚点：在两种 8B 骨干和十个医学基准上，该方法整体超过对比方案，并在罕见病任务上最高提升 5.93%。
  • 复用决定：适合医学推理监督微调与半监督强化学习；首先审计中间步骤、来源和许可。
